chapter: Touring abroad and the future of music
title: Warsaw Jazz Festival and Polish recordings
summary: The band played the Warsaw festival several times and recorded there from television and radio tapes available only locally.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe

blocks.x: You mentioned Poland. For a few years, you were going over to the Warsaw Jazz Festival.

Jazz Festival, yeah, we've been there two or three times, and -- but this was our first experience at Krakow and once again, quite lovely, and the fact that the Jazz Society was responsible for this one.
Uh-huh. On those previous occasions, you made some records, too.
All will be available? Only available there?
Yeah, they were taken off the same tapes that did the television, the radio.
